title: Figure 5. Artist's Conception of a Futuristic Warp Drive Spacecraft
description: Color digital rendering of a spacecraft with a central spherical hull and spokes inside two large ring structures, set against a starfield above a grid plane distorted by a warp bubble. Caption: "Figure 5. Artist's Conception of a Futuristic Warp Drive Spacecraft", stating the craft generates a warp bubble by locally adjusting the size of the extra space dimension. Appears under section "7.1 Adjusting Higher Dimensions for Propulsions".
